title: [DEV] Flat data error, when data is not truly flat (xDrip+ with G6)
symptom: The flat BG error is triggered frequently overnight even when the BG line is not truly flat, as seen in xDrip+ with small deviations. This can cause the loop to pause and basal to run, potentially leaving BG on target or causing it to stay elevated if not on target.
cause: The flat BG check is performed on raw values and is too sensitive, triggering even when data is not truly flat. The issue is specific to Dexcom G6 with xDrip+ as collector, and the check was originally intended for Libre issues.
fix: The fix was to limit the flat BG processing to Libre sources only, as implemented in commit 34930e323eaea5f3ca9f743c387d071882e9ee6d.
